name: desktop-empty-project-notice
goal: Show the empty project explanation as readable normal text instead of a disabled empty field

evidence: Self-review of the18 passing picker images found the disabled native No projects yet placeholder too faint at all viewports, even after removing duplicate dimming.
The previous empty guard checked DOM visibility while disabled native option painting remained faint. The same three empty cases now require normal empty-state text and no useless choice field.
